notes: Survivor-versus-juggernaut with one killer against four survivors is Survival's 1 vs All, and the Undertale/Deltarune styling is theme rather than genre. warren-looping is the preset's own shape and the shape answer settles it - short pockets off looping routes instead of true dead ends - so the P6 stands as the structural law it is. gate-escape is dropped because survivors win by outlasting the 6-minute timer, and the generators, rune pillars and dark fountains become collectible-nodes so the objectives are distributed across the map; cover-los is the hiding places and spawn-protected separates the killer's start from the survivors'. terrain-relief carries the multiple elevations, and because the prompt explicitly asks for caves, underground passages and bridges it lands on P2 rather than plain tiered; water-body is the glowing blue Waterfall water and settlement-density the Castle Town streets. Decided without a user: the buildings are read as the decorative facades the prompt calls them, with the laboratories and corridors built as contiguous parts of the one seamless map, so there is no outside-to-inside transition and no P3; the water is scenic and a barrier rather than swum, so the CHECK is really about whether the layered caves self-occlude. The lobby is deliberately not in the picks - it is a separate staging area set aside here, since the shape answer put the build on the chase map.
